_comment: Doc 1 §2.4 resolveEnding() output maps here. Each ending is a room of the building (data/rooms.json `room`) the candidate walks into: stepping into its `zone` (or `autoSeconds` passing) takes the camera -- `preShot` first if there is one, then `show` puts props in place, then the pull-back `shot` -- and a dead-still `holdSeconds` before the card (Doc 2: a 4 second hold with no motion whatsoever). `label` is the ending zone's label, if any. `flagOverlays` hide props on arrival when a flag is set. `routes` is the way on from a room that is not the ending's (the store's staff door, toward the waiting room). Doc 1 §6.4 for card text (textKey resolved via text.js against /text/endings.json). C4 is deliberately broken only on these cards -- 'you' appears exactly once per card.

flagOverlays.note: Doc 1 §2.5 / §6.4: if NEVER_SAT there is no chair for him at all in the boardroom; he remains standing at the table for the length of the hold.
He carries the package in (S8 C DELIVER sets the flag); the glass is bare until the camera leaves him, and then it is at the centre of the table (`show`).

ASSIMILATION._showNote: `self` is him, standing at the head beside his chair, revealed as the camera leaves his eyes: his face is the blurred texture map (Doc 1 §6.4).

EXPULSION._zoneNote: The storefront door stands open outward; an invisible threshold stops him in the doorway (he cannot render out there). Stepping up to it plays the ending: the camera withdraws into the store without him.

PENDING.label: TAKE A SEAT
PENDING._labelNote: S1's label again, the first thing the building asked of him.
PENDING._beatsNote: Doc 1 §6.4: seated, the slip reading 99 in his hands, the speaker clicks: 'One hundred.' Waiting on the director: `beats` (the runBeats vocabulary) are meant to run after `show`, before the pull-back `shot`; until playEnding() runs them they are inert data.

RETAINED._note: Added post-launch (Doc 1 §9.1). The same boardroom as ASSIMILATION, a shorter pull-back that keeps the package in frame. He opened the box and left it on the sorting table; the package is on the glass anyway, resealed, when he walks in.
